basis: Docly's shares reached EQT Ventures I only because Min Doktor, a Fund I company, split Docly off in Aug 2018; the fund never bought into a Docly round ('EQT Ventures declined to make a follow-up investment in Docly', Sifted). Stock received through a portfolio company's corporate event is not membership (Erik 2026-09-27 on decisions.md R2, the same class as the 2026-09-22 sale-consideration ruling); the investment is Min Doktor, which keeps its row.
